lines.t: The little children shall be My inheritance,
The babes, My jewels, shining so bright.
From the womb they come like morning stars,
Gifts of life breaking through the night.
They are precious, to be cherished in their youth,
Lights of love revealing holy truth.
More than silver, more than gold refined,
Prized above the stones the world would find.
The innocent come forth as lights from the deep,
Their laughter echoes promises I keep.
From darkness born, yet pure and free,
They carry the breath and song of Me.
They are precious, to be cherished in their youth,
Lights of love revealing holy truth.
More than silver, more than gold refined,
Prized above the stones the world would find.
Guard them gently, for their hearts are clear,
Through their eyes, My voice you’ll hear.
Every soul a spark from Heaven’s flame,
Every child called forth by name.
They are precious, to be cherished in their youth,
Lights of love revealing holy truth.
More than silver, more than gold refined,
Prized above the stones the world would find.
The little children shall be My inheritance,
The babes, My jewels, forever Mine.
[instrumental fade]
